verdict.rationale: An office suite with a spreadsheet and database could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any built-in AI insight or suggestion feature. The LanguageTool support mentioned is grammar checking, not data insights, and the SDK, macro and UNO API items are only developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
